1. **They didn’t have the best equipment.** The Italian soldiers sometimes had old or not-so-good guns and tanks, which made it hard for them to fight well.

2. **They didn’t have much training.** Some of the soldiers didn’t practice as much as other teams, so they weren’t as ready for the big game.

3. **Their leaders were not always good at making plans.** The people in charge sometimes made choices that didn’t help the team do well.

4. **They were not always motivated.** Some soldiers didn’t feel very excited or happy about playing the game, so they didn’t try their best.

5. **They had to fight against really strong teams.** The Italian team was playing against very strong teams, like the Germans and the British, which made it even harder for them.

So, that’s why the Italian Army seemed not so good at the big World War II game.
